evidenceBoundary: Deterministic scripted free providers, temporary local Git repositories/worktrees, temporary SQLite stores, and local Node verification only. No live cloud inference, external repository, packaged desktop session, or unattended hours-long run was used.

coverage: full workflow lifecycle including approval, failed verification, bounded repair, re-verification, review, and completion-gate result
real child-process crash/restart recovery across before-model, after-write, read replay, write/command replan, reviewer failure, cancellation, terminal, duplicate-lease, and missing-worktree states
mission restart recovery at planning, in-flight workstream, completed-milestone, and replanning boundaries
three-workstream synthesis interrupted after the first inclusion, then resumed without a duplicate cherry-pick and globally verified
same pinned free route retry for one retryable tool-output rejection and one short 429; recurring retryable failure terminates as failed
identical and oscillating tool loops, plus model-turn/tool-call budgets, terminate blocked rather than completed
ForgeGreen receipt persistence, duplicate finalization, and malformed/failed measurement observability
per-role model-turn exhaustion is blocked rather than presented as a completed run
final-turn completion remains possible without a false budget block
duplicate read suppression, repeated failed inspection bounds, state-change re-execution, compression, prompt-cache telemetry boundaries, and repository-analysis reuse
synthetic 100,000-file / 1,000,000-symbol repository context is bounded before provider transmission and excludes sensitive paths
final mission gate blocks unverified milestones, reviewer-rejected work, invalidated assumptions, and promotion over user changes

measured.completion: Completed workflow, resumed crash-recovery worker, resumed mission, and resumed three-workstream synthesis paths are asserted by the deterministic tests. Invalid, rejected, exhausted, and unrecoverable paths assert failed or blocked instead of success.
measured.humanIntervention: The workflow fixture records the required approval transition; restart and recovery paths resume through durable state without a simulated human repair. This is not a measurement of real-user intervention frequency.
measured.retriesAndProviderFailures: One retryable provider tool-output rejection and one short pinned-route 429 recover on the same free route. A persistent retryable failure is bounded to at most five provider calls and fails. Scripted fixtures do not quantify live provider failure rate.
measured.recovery: Process-boundary recovery preserves an observed write, replays only an unobserved read-only call, replans for unobserved writes/commands, prevents resurrection of cancellation/completion, and prevents duplicate synthesis inclusion.
measured.contextAndTokenGrowth: Role budgets cap model turns, tool calls, and 64,000 context tokens. The large-repository fixture reports 100,000 candidate files, 1,000,000 symbols, 14 selected evidence entries, and a bounded pre-provider context; it does not measure a real provider tokenizer over hours of work.
measured.verificationQuality: Verification failure invokes bounded repair in the workflow path, and mission/parallel acceptance tests require independent verification and completion-gate evidence before promotion. The fixtures do not establish hidden-test or live-repository quality rates.

proven: A multi-stage deterministic workflow can survive the tested failure/restart conditions without duplicating an observed file write or an already-included synthesis workstream.
A short retryable 429 on a pinned free route is retried without rotating the route; repeated retryable failures are bounded and truthfully fail.
Loop, retry, and model-turn exhaustion paths block or fail rather than fabricate completion, while bounded duplicate-read behavior leaves a receipt.
The tested context-selection boundary remains bounded and secret-safe at the synthetic large-repository scale.
Acceptance, reviewer, and completion-gate tests prevent unverified, stale, or user-overwritten work from being promoted.
notProven: Unattended hours-long operation, real wall-clock endurance, memory/resource leak behavior, or recovery after real machine sleep/reboot/network interruption.
Live free-provider completion, intervention rate, retry rate, provider-failure rate, token growth, context growth, or verification quality on a held-out engineering corpus.
A five-minute task is not treated as endurance evidence; this campaign is a 181.16-second deterministic multi-stage stress matrix, not an hours-long soak.
Packaged desktop endurance, browser-session endurance, and terminal-process endurance beyond their focused earlier test suites.
requiredNextEvidence: On an explicitly authorized free route and disposable local repository, run a predeclared multi-hour, checkpointed engineering corpus with redacted per-run receipts for route, calls, provider tokens, context bytes, tool actions, retries, recovery, verifier outcome, completion-gate verdict, elapsed time, and resource samples. Preserve quota or route unavailability as BLOCKED rather than synthesizing a result.
